instruction: Buy me a coffee maker on amazon within $150 (excluding tax) and have it delivered to my work address.
notes: Single-app purchase task on amazon. The search uses query/product_type = 'coffee maker' with max_price = 150 so the chosen product's pre-tax price is within budget; the static fact product-matches models the existence of such a product. add_product_to_cart is called with quantity=1 and clear_cart_first=true so the placed order contains exactly one item of quantity 1 regardless of pre-existing cart contents (CartEntry changes are ignored by the evaluation). The Work address id is read from amazon.show_addresses (no address is added/updated/deleted), and a payment card id from amazon.show_payment_cards. order-placed mirrors the new amazon.Order/OrderItem delivered to the work address; supervisor-complete-task requires it and is the only action that sets task-completed, which every other action forbids as precondition. Amazon login username is the supervisor's email.

plan: (amazon-place-order amazon-payment-card work-address amazon-token coffee-maker-product quantity-1 coffee-maker-order)
